story.iWant: to follow structured lessons that teach typing systematically
story.soThat: I can build skills progressively and track my learning journey
story.tasks:
- Task 1: Lesson Curriculum Design (AC: 1, 2) - Design comprehensive lesson progression system - Define WPM and accuracy thresholds for each lesson - Create lesson difficulty progression mapping - Implement lesson prerequisite system
- Task 2: Lesson Progress Tracking (AC: 3, 5) - Implement lesson completion status tracking - Create progress visualization components - Develop progress saving system - Add lesson history and analytics
- Task 3: Lesson Unlock System (AC: 4) - Implement skill assessment algorithms - Create lesson unlock logic based on performance - Develop lesson dependency management - Add unlock animations and notifications
- Task 4: Achievement and Certificate System (AC: 6) - Design achievement system for lesson milestones - Implement certificate generation for lesson completion - Create milestone tracking and rewards - Add achievement display in user profile
- Task 5: Lesson UI Components (AC: 1-6) - Create LessonMode component extending TypingArea - Implement lesson selection and progression interface - Create lesson status visualization - Add achievement and certificate display components
- Task 6: Testing and Quality Assurance (All ACs) - Unit tests for lesson progression logic - Unit tests for unlock algorithms - Integration tests with existing typing engine - Performance testing for lesson loading

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Given I select Lesson mode, when I start lessons then structured lesson progression is displayed 2. Given I select Lesson mode, when I start lessons then each lesson has specific WPM and accuracy thresholds 3. Given I select Lesson mode, when I start lessons then completion status is tracked and visualized 4. Given I complete lessons, when I finish then new lessons unlock based on performance 5. Given I complete lessons, when I finish then my progress through lesson system is saved 6. Given I complete lessons, when I finish then certificates or achievements are awarded for milestones

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR-026: Structured lesson progression system, FR-027: Define WPM and accuracy thresholds for lesson completion, FR-028: Track lesson progress and completion status, FR-029: Unlock new lessons based on performance

doc.title: System Architecture
doc.snippet: Component-based React architecture with feature-based organization, unidirectional data flow, and Firebase as backend-as-a-service

doc.title: Frontend Architecture
doc.snippet: Build custom components using Tailwind CSS for complete design control and consistency, lightweight approach with no additional component library overhead

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Implement diverse practice modes (Quote, Word, Character, Lesson, Code, Numbers) that provide varied typing experiences catering to different learning needs and skill levels

code.reason: Core typing component providing character-by-character highlighting and input handling. Must be extended for Lesson Mode.
Comprehensive typing engine with session management, metrics calculation, and timer functionality. Provides WPM, accuracy, and performance tracking integration.
Comprehensive progress visualization components including specialized components for lessons, WPM tracking, accuracy display, and category progress cards.
Results display modal patterns that should be followed for lesson completion and achievement displays.
Existing mode selection system that needs to be updated to include Lesson mode option.
Firebase integration for storing lesson data, user progress, achievements, and certificates.
Existing type system that will be extended with Lesson and Achievement types.

constraint.name: Performance Requirement
constraint.description: Must maintain existing typing latency (<50ms performance requirement)

constraint.name: Architecture Pattern
constraint.description: Extend existing TypingArea component to maintain consistency with previous modes

constraint.name: Data Storage
constraint.description: Use established Firebase patterns for storing lesson progress and achievements

constraint.name: Component Consistency
constraint.description: Follow existing component organization patterns and leverage existing ProgressBar components

constraint.name: Progress Tracking
constraint.description: Progress tracking must be real-time and persistent with proper data synchronization

constraint.name: Lesson Structure
constraint.description: Implement structured learning path with clear prerequisites and adaptive unlock criteria

constraint.name: Achievement Integration
constraint.description: Achievement system should integrate with existing user progress and future analytics features

tests.standards: Unit tests using Jest and React Testing Library following existing patterns. Test files should be co-located with components using .test.tsx naming convention. Integration testing with Firebase Firestore emulator. Performance testing for lesson loading and unlock algorithms. Target 80% code coverage for new Lesson mode components.
